thread:
rachel (PM): quick sync: pilot customers asking for a compact Console panel to show reserved pool usage, burst credits, and the active autoscale policy. can we scope an MLP?

omar (Eng): minimal backend: tenant-aggregated usage + burst_balance + policy_name. cheap to surface if we reuse billing agg.

rachel (PM): MLP should be: panel with 3 numbers, last_synced_ts, and a link to docs. stretch: CSV.

kevin (SRE): must-have: audit log for policy changes, permission checks, and a rate-limit on the status endpoint. also surface rejection reasons in logs.

anya (Design): I can make a compact horizontal card: left metric stack, right a small policy dropdown (read-only in pilot). will deliver lo-fi today.

tess (Sales): customers also want clear wording about charges when Burst is enabled. include a small banner.

omar (Eng): API sketch: GET /api/v1/tenants/:id/pool-summary -> {reserved_1h, reserved_24h, burst_balance, policy, last_synced}. CSV as download endpoint.

rachel (PM): acceptance: panel live in Console, status API, audit entries, docs + sales banner. timeline: pilot read-only in 2w, full write controls in 6w.

kevin (SRE): ops plan: allow manual ops override during incidents, add alert when used% > 85% for 5m.

anya (Design): will include copy variants for the banner and tooltip for "burst credits".

tess (Sales): i'll align pilot customers and ask if CSV unblocks them.

omar (Eng): I'll spike reuse of billing aggregator today and report back by EOD.

rachel (PM): thanks. I'll create the roadmap ticket and mark pilot vs MLP scope.
